name: DO&GS
source:
Where death is celebrated, this little chocolate dogs have nothing but each other to pass the time up until they get eaten.

[from [url=https://kommei.itch.io/dogs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在庆祝死亡的地方，这只小巧克力狗除了互相打发时间之外别无他物，直到被吃掉。

[来自[url=https://kommei.itch.io/dogs]itch.io[/url]]
